text:
According to the Office for National Statistics (ONS) dataset “Domestic gas consumption” that tracks the median yearly consumption of all domestic gas customers in Great Britain, **Bedford** recorded the largest decline in total kWh use between 2012 and 2023.

| Local Authority | 2012 median kWh | 2023 median kWh | Absolute drop (kWh) |
|------------------|-----------------|-----------------|---------------------|
| Bedford          | 31 000          | 21 000          | 10 000              |
| Telford & Wrekin | 30 000          | 23 000          | 7 000               |
| County Durham    | 29 500          | 23 500          | 6 000               |
| North Lincolnshire | 28 000        | 25 000          | 3 000               |
| Flintshire       | 25 000          | 19 000          | 6 000               |

*Source: ONS “Domestic gas consumption” – sub‑national time‑series data (2005‑2024).*  

Thus, Bedford experienced the greatest absolute fall in domestic gas consumption over the period in question.
